baseline.rule: Freeze baseline timestamp and source series before comparison. Report raw deltas and trailing-standardized deltas. Missing factors suppress the composite; do not silently reweight. Score is not a forecast return or probability.
baseline.credit: Same-tenor ORCL spread/CDS series; Treasury plus spread for new issuance. Separate fixed, floating, refinancing and new debt.
baseline.rates: 2y/10y nominal yields, real yields and curve; falling yields with widening credit may indicate stress rather than relief.
baseline.energy_inflation: WTI/Brent and inflation breakevens; separate Iran headlines from verified supply effects. USO is a futures-based proxy.
baseline.execution: RPO conversion, utilization, capacity energization, funding, margin and cash conversion; distinguish issuer claims from observations.

panels.title: Price and dollar volume
panels.contract: Timestamped entitled observations; regular and extended sessions separate. Exact dollar volume is sum(price*size); bar VWAP*volume is labeled a bar aggregate; close*volume only an estimate.

panels.title: Narrow touch bands and regime
panels.contract: Each zone carries endpoints, session, lookback, method/version and source revision IDs. Distinct excursions require exit/reset before recounting. Volume for bars touching a band is not exact volume inside it and overlapping bands are not additive. Regimes: balance, trend_up, trend_down, expansion, event_dislocation or unknown. Never force a chop classification.

panels.title: QQQ / NVDA / IBM divergence
panels.contract: Align timestamps, sessions and return basis. Estimate lagged rolling coefficients without lookahead. Raw relative returns differ from beta-adjusted residuals. Separate single-factor regressions are not additive. HYG/IEF/USO are imperfect proxies, not causal decompositions.

panels.title: Weighted macro baseline and deltas
panels.contract: Keep frequency/availability per series; each delta needs fixed baseline source ID and current source ID. Standardize using prior-window changes, with a declared window and sign convention. No dollar price effect without fitted, validated sensitivities. Suppress score on missing or stale inputs.

panels.title: Revenue, margins and cash conversion
panels.contract: Most recent filing checked daily; observed_at is review time, effective_at is fiscal period end. Store period, GAAP/non-GAAP basis, reconciliation, actual/guidance status. RPO is not profit; prepayments and customer equipment are not unrestricted free cash flow. Quarterly versus trailing periods must not mix.

panels.title: Debt, credit and capacity economics
panels.contract: Rates relief affects floating/refinanced/new debt differently. Track power, GPU depreciation, financing, network cost, utilization and rack-to-revenue time; do not assume partner cost pass-through or economic life changes accounting policy.

panels.title: Partners and revenue transmission
panels.contract: Track NVIDIA supply/ecosystem; Microsoft/AWS/Google database distribution; OpenAI capacity/customer exposure; IBM/Red Hat interoperability; systems integrators; Alloy/sovereign delivery; Health. Announced, contracted, deployed and revenue-recognized are distinct. Do not count a partner's revenue as Oracle revenue.

panels.title: Catalysts, thesis changes and falsifiers
panels.contract: Earnings, filings, financing, capacity, customer contracts and Iran/oil/inflation news. Separate verified events, issuer statements and hypotheses; retain contradictory evidence and revision history.

panels.title: Relative value and conditional price ranges
panels.contract: Consume explicit annual NTM horizons and matching earnings/lease bases. Current forward-multiple indications are conditional scenarios, never probabilities or future price targets. Negative FCF remains visible; incomplete peer coverage suppresses that implied price. Keep synthetic runs separate. Every dependency must be fresh.
